select HISTORY_ID, PRODUCT_ID, T.TRADE_TYPE, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, FINAL_PRICE, to_char(COMPLETED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "COMPLETED_AT_STR", COMPLETED_AT, P.TITLE, U.NICKNAME as "PARTNER_NICKNAME" from TRANSACTION_HISTORY T join PRODUCTS P using (PRODUCT_ID) join USERS U on U.USER_NO = case when T.BUYER_NO = #{userNo} then T.SELLER_NO when T.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} then T.BUYER_NO end where (BUYER_NO = #{userNo} or SELLER_NO = #{userNo})
order by COMPLETED_AT desc

select count(*) from TRANSACTION_HISTORY T join PRODUCTS P using (PRODUCT_ID) join USERS U on U.USER_NO = case when T.BUYER_NO = #{userNo} then T.SELLER_NO when T.SELLER_NO = #{userNo} then T.BUYER_NO end where (BUYER_NO = #{userNo} or SELLER_NO = #{userNo})
mapper.insert: insert into TRANSACTION_HISTORY (PRODUCT_ID, TRADE_TYPE, SELLER_NO, BUYER_NO, FINAL_PRICE) values (#{productId}, #{tradeType}, #{sellerNo}, #{buyerNo}, #{finalPrice})
